purpose: Make video-game research pay rent by binding extracted mechanics to current FIELD hosts with explicit non-transfer residue and executable/contractual proof.
selection_gate: no new sovereign app without missing function

transfers.invariant: Re-entry may expose what is known plus an already-declared unresolved edge without creating a quest, priority or obligation.
transfers.implementation: FIELD held object renders MORE HERE inside collapsed focus RESIDUE, derived only from evolution.question, open_gaps, or unresolved field.exit_paths. The former CATCH + ACT aggregate is retired.
transfers.proof_claim: Current root keeps knowledge-gap evidence attached to the held route in focusResidue without creating task, priority, obligation or canonical read state.
transfers.retirement: No extra store or route. If held MORE HERE adds noise without improving re-entry, remove that projection; the source evidence remains owned by manifest/CURRENT.

transfers.invariant: A failed bounded attempt should return new evidence/residue or be recognized as duplicate churn; failure is not a blank reset.
transfers.implementation: field-egress-reducer accepts explicit FAILURE_RETURN / failure_return with four bounded classes: NEW_EVIDENCE, CHANGED_ASSUMPTION, NARROWED_UNKNOWN, DUPLICATE_NO_NEW_INFO. Material failure returns survive as RESIDUE; duplicate-no-new-info cannot manufacture NEXT; contradictory duplicate + material residue is preserved for review rather than discarded.
transfers.proof_claim: Packet egress now makes the Hades-style failure-return law executable without inferring failure meaning from generic prose or rewarding failure with score/progression.
transfers.retirement: Keep the explicit failure-return field only while it prevents duplicate blind retries; fold it into a broader typed RETURN contract if another current owner supersedes the same semantics.

transfers.invariant: Preparation should answer expected route/environment friction; loadout quality is relational to body + carried modules + route/world, not inventory completeness.
non_transfer: digital loadout treated as physical safety proof
transfers.implementation: BODY/FIT already owns LOADOUT → SET OUT → RETURN → PATINA → NEXT CUT with known mass/power/service metadata and purpose-specific kits. Proposed bounded coupling: optional route-friction descriptors filter/suggest relevant capabilities without scoring the body or claiming physical safety.
transfers.proof_claim: Existing BODY/FIT release/RETURN proves the preparation-return carrier; route-friction filtering remains proposed and is not claimed implemented.
transfers.retirement: If route-friction descriptors do not reduce preparation translation, omit them; preserve the existing loadout/RETURN loop unchanged.

transfers.invariant: When effects are predictable, expose affected addresses and reversible/irreversible boundary before authoritative commit; uncertainty stays visible.
transfers.implementation: FIELD held-object FORECAST derives effect class, authority/commit boundary, target, source-mutation class and reversibility from declared action metadata. The forecast is reading-only and native hosts retain commit/effect authority.
transfers.proof_claim: FIELD 0.8.29 shipped declared pre-commit FORECAST without claiming perfect information or moving native commit authority.
transfers.retirement: No extra UI required when native host already exposes equivalent preview.

transfers.invariant: A proposal may carry rich configuration while remaining explicitly non-real and non-actuating until resources, authority and enactment arrive.
transfers.proof_claim: Execution contract names PROPOSED/GHOST as non-real and incapable of increasing world authority.
transfers.retirement: Ghost disappears when enacted, rejected, superseded or no longer addressable.

transfers.invariant: Temporary support exists to restore or unlock capability and should name the condition under which it can be removed.
transfers.proof_claim: Execution contract requires temporary support/helper surfaces to name a retirement condition.
transfers.retirement: This rule itself may fold into a more general lifecycle contract once enforced elsewhere.

transfers.invariant: Keep the represented body/room visible; attach a small locus-specific aperture with at most three existing host-lawful operations; local condition never becomes a global score or new authority.
transfers.implementation: CARE body-map locus exposes OBSERVE/PRIOR/COURSE; HOUSE selected-room locus exposes CARE/BODY/DAYLINE. Each delegates to native host operations and disappears outside compatible projections.
transfers.proof_claim: Phone-sized browser probes click real CARE/HOUSE loci, verify the represented map/room remains visible, aperture stays spatially inside its host surface, and native host actions remain the effect path.
transfers.retirement: Remove host-local aperture if it obscures the represented substrate, duplicates host navigation without reducing translation, or grows beyond three immediate actions. Shared runtime extraction requires a third unequal consumer or material duplicated logic.

transfers.invariant: Hardspace: deconstruction is a dependency-graph operation whose cut order matters. Terra Nil: temporary support should disappear after capability/world recovery. FIELD combines them conservatively: survey blockers, preserve transferable mechanism/provenance/RETURN, and never let retirement classification authorize deletion.
non_transfer: absence of internal references treated as proof of zero external dependence
transfers.implementation: Read-only /lib/field-salvage-core.mjs + scripts/field-salvage-audit.mjs classify routes against CURRENT/head authority, children, aliases and live refs. This is the implemented Hardspace-style dependency survey; ordered cut planning is deliberately not automated. Terra-Nil-style scaffold retirement remains contract-owned.
transfers.proof_claim: Synthetic classifier proves CURRENT heads, frozen donors, compatibility aliases and live references resist retirement; only an already-explicit SUPERSEDED / DEPRECATED / RETIRED / REMOVED signal with no detected blockers may become RETIRE_CANDIDATE.
transfers.retirement: Fold this audit into a more general lifecycle checker if another current mechanism owns identical dependency/salvage/cut proof; never preserve the checker merely because it exists.
